name: ReadFormulaFromExcelNode
label: Read Formula from Excel
description: Reads the formula (not the calculated value) from a specified cell in an Excel worksheet.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet from which to read the formula.

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Column
fields.description: The column letter or number of the cell containing the formula.

fields.name: Row
fields.label: Row
fields.description: The row number of the cell containing the formula.

fields.name: Formula
fields.label: Formula
fields.description: The formula text from the specified cell.

fields.name: HasFormula
fields.label: Has Formula
fields.description: Indicates whether the cell actually contains a formula.
